description: Nine independently authored synthetic regression cases. Pipeline starter only; below the 120-case release gate. Labels are for independent review and must not enter model prompts.

memories.content: The development proxy listens on port 7903 on loopback only. Production exposure has not been reviewed.
Local development uses a loopback proxy on port 7903. Whether production can expose it is unverified.

facts.claim: Development proxy port is 7903.
Binding is loopback only.
Production exposure remains unverified.

forbidden: Production internet exposure is safe or has been verified.

memories.content: The staging mail worker drops every outbound message after rendering. This prevents test mail reaching customers.
The production mail worker delivers verified transactional messages to customers; it does not drop all messages.

facts.claim: Staging drops outbound mail after rendering.
Production delivers verified transactional mail.

memories.content: The museum ticket allows entry on the booked day.
The hotel reservation includes one printed guest voucher.

associations.reason: The booked museum promotion requires the hotel guest voucher at entry; co-recall avoids forgetting it.
associations.context: Only the September partner promotion for this booking. It is not a general requirement for museum entry.

facts.claim: Museum entry is on the booked day.
This hotel reservation includes a guest voucher.
Voucher linkage applies only to this booking's September partner promotion.

forbidden: All museum visitors need a hotel voucher.

memories.content: Alex Chen on the Atlas backend team owns database migration reviews. This record is specific to Atlas.
Alex Chen at the external studio coordinates illustrations for the Cedar booklet. Identity matching with other Alex Chens has not been established.

facts.claim: Atlas migration reviews belong to its backend Alex Chen.
Cedar illustrations are coordinated by the external studio Alex Chen.
No evidence establishes these are the same person.

forbidden: A single Alex Chen is confirmed to own both roles.

memories.content: Review of inventory/reserve.ts found a transaction around local stock reservation. A unit test exercised one worker; cross-process races were not tested.
Review of inventory/release.ts found compensation for a failed local reservation. The test covered a single database connection. Production failover has not been tested.

facts.claim: Local reserve uses a transaction; only one worker was tested.
Local release compensates failed reservations on one connection.
Cross-process races and production failover remain untested.

forbidden: The inventory system is verified race-free under production failover.

memories.content: The August project note scheduled the design sync for Tuesdays at 10:00.
The signed September update moves the design sync to Thursdays at 14:00, starting September 10. The August schedule is historical.

facts.claim: Tuesday 10:00 describes the historical August schedule.
Thursday 14:00 applies starting September 10.

forbidden: Both times describe the current recurring meeting.
The new schedule applied before September 10.

memories.content: The office label printer pauses jobs while its thermal head cools.
The dispatch desk keeps a tray of labels produced earlier in the same shift.

associations.reason: During cooling pauses the earlier-label tray lets dispatch continue, so the fallback should be recalled with the pause.
associations.context: Only labels for the same destination and current shift may be reused. Old or mismatched labels must never be substituted.

facts.claim: The thermal head cooling pause stops current printing.
There is a current-shift earlier-label tray.
Fallback applies only to same-destination current-shift labels.

forbidden: Any old label can be used during a printer pause.

memories.content: For the Riverside site inspection on October 9, visitors must check in at the south security desk before entering the equipment room.
The October 9 Riverside visitor pass is valid only when paired with the signed inspection invitation. The invitation is stored in the project handover folder.

facts.claim: Riverside inspection visitors check in at the south security desk before equipment-room entry.
The October 9 visitor pass needs the signed invitation.
The pass and invitation condition is specific to this inspection, not a general building-access rule.

forbidden: Every Riverside visit requires this October 9 invitation.

memories.content: The app repository uses pnpm with a checked-in pnpm-lock.yaml. Its documented frozen installation command is pnpm install --frozen-lockfile.
The separate docs repository uses npm with package-lock.json and validates dependencies with npm ci. No migration of either repository has been requested.

facts.claim: App uses pnpm and its frozen-lockfile command.
Docs uses npm ci and package-lock.json.
No migration between package managers was requested.

forbidden: Both repositories should use npm ci.
A package manager migration has already been approved.
